evidence: From the car park at the end of Mt Richmond Road, the track follows Te Hoiere/Pelorus River for an hour to Emerald Pool, an ideal fishing, swimming and picnicking spot.

From Red Hills Hut, the Te Araroa Track continues to climb Maitland Ridge for 7.9km to Beebys Knob Road. Then the Beebys Knob Road descends for 3.7km to meet Tophouse Road near the Lowther Road turnoff.

evidence: You can also start the Richmond Ranges Te Araroa Track from the Hacket Track car park.
Hacket Track starts at the picnic area by the Hacket Track car park.
Continue along Hacket Track to Hacket Hut.

via.name: junction shortly before Bushy Top
via.quote: the sign-posted junction shortly before Bushy Top

evidence: From Tarn Hut, exit to Goulter road end
At the sign-posted junction shortly before Bushy Top (see above), the left-hand branch leads to the Goulter road end.
From the hut, the track carries on for 45 minutes to a 4WD road end.

ways.label: Exit option: from Mid Wairoa Hut to Wairoa Road end
evidence: From Mid Wairoa Hut, exit to Wairoa Road end
The track follows the Wairoa River which has steep difficult sidles to negotiate, before opening out onto a forestry road. Follow the road for about 4 km until you reach the locked gate.

doubts: The end is where Beebys Knob Road meets Tophouse Road near the Lowther Road turnoff; no feature matches (the road end features are where the Red Hills Track meets State Highway 63, a different route) and the Tophouse place entry (T49) is not clearly the same spot, so the end ref is null. The start ref F4 (where Pelorus Track meets Mount Richmond Road) is taken as the car park at the end of Mt Richmond Road. The Hacket Track alternative entrance has its own heading and time (2 hr, to Hacket Hut only); I recorded it as a whole way from the Hacket Track car park joining the main route at Hacket Hut, with no overall time. The two exit options (Tarn Hut to Goulter road end, Mid Wairoa Hut to Wairoa Road end) are bail-out routes with their own headings and times; recorded as separate ways starting at those huts, their ends have no matching feature. The track between Mid Wairoa Hut and Rocks Track names is not given as map track names; 'Rocks Track' and 'Alpine Route' are not in names. Lower Goulter Hut lies on the Goulter exit only, not on the main way. Old Man Hut and Tarn Hut are reached by short sign-posted access tracks off the main ridge. No overall distance is given.
